families.label: Spur
families.description: Straight external involute teeth for parallel shafts.
families.pairing: Match normal module and pressure angle. Check centre distance and total pair tooth thinning.

families.label: Helical
families.description: External teeth with a continuous helical twist.
families.pairing: Match normal module, normal pressure angle and helix magnitude. Parallel external shafts require opposite helix hands.

families.label: Herringbone
families.description: Two opposed helical halves meeting at the centre plane.
families.pairing: Match both helix halves, normal module and pressure angle. This design has no centre relief groove.

families.label: Internal spur
families.description: Involute teeth on the inside of a ring.
families.pairing: A mating external pinion requires a separate interference and assembly check. Tooth-count difference alone is insufficient.

families.label: Internal helical
families.description: Helical internal teeth with a surrounding ring.
families.pairing: Match normal module, pressure angle and the same helix hand for parallel shafts. Check internal-gear interference.

families.label: Internal herringbone
families.description: Opposed helical tooth traces inside a ring.
families.pairing: Check tooth compatibility and assembly access: a closed herringbone ring may prevent insertion of the mating pinion.

families.label: Straight rack
families.description: Linear involute-system rack with straight tooth traces.
families.pairing: Match the pinion's normal module and pressure angle. Set the pinion axis at the required reference height.

families.label: Helical rack
families.description: Linear rack with angled tooth traces.
families.pairing: Match the pinion's normal module, pressure angle and compatible tooth-trace direction.

families.label: Worm
families.description: Screw gear generated from the normal rack profile.
families.pairing: Use an enveloped wheel generated for this exact module, pressure angle, pitch diameter and start count.

families.label: Worm wheel
families.description: Enveloped wheel generated by a matching worm.
families.pairing: The generating worm diameter and starts are part of this wheel's definition. Use a matching worm at the documented centre distance.

families.label: Straight bevel
families.pairing: Generate the mate with exchanged tooth counts and the same shaft angle, module and pressure angle. Align their cone apexes.

families.label: Spiral bevel
families.description: Spherical-involute bevel teeth with a spiral trace.
families.pairing: Generate both gears as a compatible pair with exchanged tooth counts and appropriate opposite spiral hands. Not a hypoid generator.

families.label: Crown / face
families.description: Face gear generated by a matching cylindrical pinion.
families.pairing: Use the specified generating pinion. Verify face-gear radial limits and shaft placement for the complete pair.

width.label: Radial face width
width.description: Radial tooth-face width, centred on the crown's pitch radius.

module.label: Normal module
module.description: Tooth size in the normal plane. For spur gears this is also the transverse module.

teeth.label: Teeth
teeth.description: A whole number of teeth. On a rack, the number of full tooth pitches.

pressure_angle.label: Normal pressure angle
pressure_angle.description: Pressure angle in the normal plane. Use the same value on mating gears.

width.label: Face width
width.description: Axial gear width. For bevel gears, width along the pitch cone.

bore.label: Bore diameter
bore.description: Straight circular shaft opening. Enter zero for a solid centre.

backlash.label: Tooth thinning
backlash.description: This gear's tooth-thickness reduction at the normal reference section. Pair clearance includes both gears' reductions; it is not applied twice automatically.

profile_shift.label: Profile shift
profile_shift.description: Normal profile shift coefficient. Shifted mating gears require a compatible centre distance.

addendum.label: Addendum coefficient
addendum.description: Tooth height above the reference surface, expressed in modules.

dedendum.label: Dedendum coefficient
dedendum.description: Tooth depth below the reference surface, expressed in modules.

root_fillet.label: Root fillet coefficient
root_fillet.description: Generating tool tip radius divided by normal module. The generated tooth root is a trochoidal profile, not an applied edge fillet.

helix_angle.label: Helix angle
helix_angle.description: Signed pitch helix angle. Reverse the sign for the opposite hand. External gears on parallel shafts use opposite hands; internal pairs use the same hand.

outside_diameter.label: Ring outside diameter
outside_diameter.description: Outside diameter of the surrounding ring. Must leave material beyond the tooth roots.

crown_base.label: Base thickness
crown_base.description: Solid face-gear backing below the tooth roots.

rack_height.label: Rack height
rack_height.description: Distance from the rack reference line to its flat back, including the dedendum.

worm_diameter.label: Worm pitch diameter
worm_diameter.description: Reference diameter of this worm or the worm that generates a wheel.

worm_hand.label: Thread hand
worm_hand.description: Enter 1 for right hand or -1 for left hand. A worm and its wheel must use the same hand setting.

worm_starts.label: Worm starts
worm_starts.description: Number of intertwined worm threads. Must match the mating worm or wheel.

mate_teeth.label: Mating gear teeth
mate_teeth.description: Whole tooth count of the mating gear; required to establish the pitch cone or generating pinion.

spiral_angle.label: Spiral angle
spiral_angle.description: Signed bevel tooth spiral angle at the reference cone.
